ModuleName: Introduction to PreseMaker: What It Is and How It Works

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: A structured outline of the module's topics covering what PreseMaker is, who it is designed for, its content hierarchy, workflow, and AI assistance features, used by instructors to preview the module's scope and by learners to orient themselves before engaging with the content.

Artifacts.Name: What Is PreseMaker?
Artifacts.Description: A reading page explaining what PreseMaker is — a native Windows course authoring application built specifically to help users create structured, ready-to-deliver learning materials — used by learners to understand the tool's purpose and how it differs from browser-based or general-purpose alternatives.

Artifacts.Name: Who Is PreseMaker For?
Artifacts.Description: A reading page describing the specific professional audiences PreseMaker is designed for, including instructional designers, corporate trainers, and educators, used by learners to understand whether and how the tool fits their role and work context.

Artifacts.Name: The Course → Module → Content Hierarchy
Artifacts.Description: A reading page explaining PreseMaker's mandatory three-level organizational structure of Course, Module, and Content, used by learners to understand how learning programs are architecturally built, navigated, and maintained within the application.

Artifacts.Name: The PreseMaker Workflow Overview
Artifacts.Description: A reading page walking learners through PreseMaker's end-to-end authoring workflow — from creating a blank course and defining its structure to generating and finalizing content — used by learners to understand the repeatable process they will follow for any project.

Artifacts.Name: How AI Assistance Works in PreseMaker
Artifacts.Description: A reading page explaining how artificial intelligence is integrated into PreseMaker's authoring workflow to help users move from an empty project to structured learning content more quickly, used by learners to understand the role and limits of AI assistance in the tool.

Artifacts.Name: How AI Assistance Works in PreseMaker
